decision.accepted_edge: Accept only exact positive owned contractual compensation actually received by an already approved market maker for independently justified legitimate organic qualifying liquidity, after every contractual obligation, rejected or missed payment, inventory, adverse selection, hedge, spread, fee, latency, capital, custody, compliance, support, tax, opportunity, termination, clawback, and incremental cost.
decision.adjudication_rule: Bind approval and current eligibility, contract category, qualifying markets and activity, quote obligations, uptime, size, spread, performance measurement, payment formula, asset, cadence, cap, discretion, withholding, clawback, suspension, termination, renewal, and change rights. An application route, qualitative incentive claim, discretionary negotiation, or future owned-payment predicate without deterministic economics leaves the public forward profit floor at zero.

limitations: Market-maker compensation requires an independently legitimate liquidity business and organic external demand; it cannot justify manufacturing orders, quotes, fills, volume, or exposure.
The retained index title and description are source-selection evidence only and cannot establish approval, obligations, payout, persistence, collection, or profit.
No contact, application, account, agreement, configuration, quote, order, cancellation, fill, transfer, fund movement, credential, or transaction is authorized.
